spice_geometry: DE421 SPK provides Sun and Moon state geometry in J2000.
moon_pa_de421_1900-2050.bpc orients the Moon in MOON_PA_DE421 relative to J2000.
moon_080317.tf defines MOON_ME_DE421 (frame ID 31001) relative to MOON_PA_DE421 (frame ID 31006).
spkpos("SUN", ET, "MOON_ME_DE421", "NONE", "MOON") returns the Moon-center-to-Sun vector in MOON_ME_DE421.
terrain_map_conversion: Site01 projected X/Y are not treated as Cartesian body-fixed coordinates.
The team method applies the documented spherical south-polar stereographic inverse with R=1737400 m, central meridian 0 degrees, x=east, y=north, and MOON_ME_DE421 axes.
The DEM height is added radially to the mapped unit vector to form the local surface point.
Local map tangent basis vectors and DEM surface normals are computed from finite differences in the projected raster coordinates.
frame_transformation_chain.compatibility_note: The selected epoch is within both DE421 SPK and moon_pa_de421_1900-2050.bpc coverage. The map-to-body inverse is a documented team-derived approximation because PGDA distributes projected raster products rather than a SPICE DSK.
